text:
lucas: Heads-up 11am visitor bringing two potted plants and a framed print (museum drop-off). Where's best to stash them and do I need a temp badge? cc @frontdesk :deciduous_tree:
frontdesk: We can hold small plants at the desk. Framed art >50cm should go to Mailroom B or Offsite Storage D if oversized. Temp badge yes 10min before arrival is fine. Please label 'fragile' if glass.
erin: If they're coming by van, ask courier to use Loading Dock A between 9-10 to avoid the delivery crush. We also have an elevator reservation slot at 10:15 if you need it 10min block reserved.
jas: I have a rolling trolley we can borrow for art. Ping me and I'll wheel it to the lobby. Also reminder: mailroom lockers are near capacity this week.
people-ops-bot: Temp badge request queued for Lucas's guest: BADGE-991. Valid 04/10 08:00-18:00. Visitor QR: https://redwood.example/checkin/BADGE-991.
lucas: Thanks all. Courier ETA 09:50, crate dims 98x68x10cm, not heavy. I'll add FRAGILE sticker. Can someone meet to bring it into Huddle C?
ern: sorry typo
erin: I can meet at 09:45. Reply with "meet" if you can help carry the print to Huddle C.
jas: meet
nora: can help after 10:00, in a call until then
frontdesk: Noted 1 we'll keep one visitor sticker and badge at desk. If kiosk is down, use manual form: https://redwood.example/manual-visitor. For packages routed to Offsite Storage D please include "hold-for-lucas" in label.
lucas: Also quick seating question 1 can we reserve the north high-top for 11:00-12:00 for post-talk mingle? I won't block it permanently, just a sticky note on the whiteboard.
jas: That's fine. I'll put a "guest mngl" sticky and add calendar 11:00-11:45.
erin: Small poll: anyone allergic to nuts? Reply "nuts" if yes so we avoid nutty snacks.
lucas: Thanks everyone  I'll DM the courier plate and call-out on arrival. 
frontdesk: All set. We'll call Lucas's desk extension when courier arrives. :phone:
